name: Zigana Tunnel (1988)
facts: Opened in 1988, the Zigana Tunnel stretches 1,702 meters through the Pontic Mountains, a feat completed in just two years after the breakthrough on September 2, 1977.
With a single tube that is 11.20 meters wide and 8.50 meters high, the tunnel accommodates one lane of traffic in each direction, ensuring safe passage at elevations between 1,820 and 1,795 meters.

A second, 14,481‑meter twin‑tube Zigana Tunnel opened in 2023, dramatically reducing travel time between Güzelyayla, Maçka and Köstere, Torul while lowering the elevation to between 1,253 and 1,211 meters.
